rubricName: Security - OWASP Top 10:2025 - Hospitality Analytics Pipeline

evalCriteria.prompt: Review every changed .sql/.yml/.env file. Score 0 if any changed file contains a literal AWS access key, secret key, Snowflake password, or any other credential value that is not routed through env_var() or a Snowflake Storage Integration object. Cite the file and line.

Review every changed dbt model (.sql) for Jinja-templated values that are concatenated into SQL without dbt's own parameterization/quoting mechanisms (e.g. raw string interpolation of user- or config-supplied values into a query without {{ }} escaping). Score 0 if any changed model does this. Cite the file and line.

Review the new/changed GitHub Actions workflow file(s). Score 0 if any step pins an action or dependency to an unpinned/mutable ref (e.g. @main, @master, a floating tag) instead of a pinned version/SHA, or installs a package from an unofficial/untrusted source. Cite the file and line.

Review changed Snowflake DDL (Stage.sql, Create_Table.sql) and dbt config (profiles.yml, dbt_project.yml). Score 0 if any changed config grants overly broad access (e.g. a stage or storage integration scoped wider than the specific S3 path/bucket needed) or leaves a default/insecure setting where a secure alternative was available and documented. Cite the file and line.

Review changed dbt models/tests for data-integrity enforcement. Score 0 if a new schema test (unique/not_null/relationships/accepted_values) is declared but does not actually reference a real, existing model/column (a test that silently never runs is a data-integrity failure, not a passing safeguard). Cite the file and line.
